tasks.title: Name canonical Todo hierarchy row controls in Tasks and Projects
tasks.body:
Goal:
Name repeated canonical Todo hierarchy actions and disclosures.

Current behavior:
The Tasks route configures TodoTaskPanel with ShowTaskList false and renders TodoHierarchyPanel rows. Projects embeds the same hierarchy component. Repeated completion, branch, edit, subtask, move, organization and reference controls lack record context. Parent task research listed only the shared task panel, which cannot cover the visible Todo rows.

Desired behavior:
Add safe displayed task context to repeated row and focused-context actions, retaining visible action text. Give Notes and References disclosures stable controlled content identities while retaining native expansion behavior. Distinguish names that collapse to identical browser whitespace. Preserve exact handlers and read-only branch navigation.

Touch:
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/Components/TodoHierarchyPanel.razor`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Workspace/TodoHierarchyPanelTests.cs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-hierarchy-names-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`

Implementation constraints:
No branch policy, project membership, parent attachment, command, approval, consent or provider behavior changes. Existing Add subtask and Move workflows remain explicitly reviewed. Only actual disclosure controls expose expansion semantics; opening a branch context is navigation. Local synthetic build/test authorization applies. Physical devices and assistive technology remain unqualified.

Validation:
Add public failing regressions before changing names. Exercise Tasks and the Project-mode hierarchy with valid owned synthetic documents, same displayed names, exact actions, original review fences and no acceptance. Retain existing hierarchy recovery, archive, cycle, placement and independent membership tests. Qualify both changed routes across all declared widths, normal/enlarged text and three light/dark schemes including obsidian-glow.
